tei:div.tei:p: 503)thod rgal 'ja' lus mngon 'grub kyi skabs don la/ thog mar mchod brjod kyi gnas dang nye gnas khyad par/ phyi gnas yul dur khrod la gnas dang*/ nang rdo rje'i lus la tshang ba la nye gnas/ zhing dang nye zhing yang de bzhin dang*/ spyir mchod brjod skabs dbyings dang dbyings bzhugs kyi khyad par dbyings chos sku dang*/ dbyings bzhugs gzugs sku bzhin lag gi rnam pa can du bzhengs pa'o/ phyi'i ru shan skabs su gnas kyi bye brag ni/ rab dur khrod/ 'bring nags tshal/ tha ma mtsho gling sogs mi'i rgyu 'grul med pa'i sar rnal 'byor pas lus gcer bur phyungs nas smad du gsang dgos mnabs/ ang rag yin kyang chog rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis gsang gos dang stod g.yogs mnabs/ jo ser gnyis gnas so sor 'gro'o/ nang gi ru shan skabs su thun skabs re la dmyal ba'i sa bon la dmigs nas 'bru gsum bzlas pa ci nus bzla/ mthar thun grol ran dus yi dwags nas lha'i bar re re bzhin 'bru gsum bzlas pa brgya rtsa re bzla zhing thun grol bar bya'o/ 504)thun gzhan rnams la'ang des 'gres so/ dmyal ba sbyangs tshar rjes dmyal ba dor te yi dwags nas mgo bzung zhing gong ltar byed/ de'i 'gros kyis rigs drug po song rjes kha skong 'bum ther gyi tshe na rigs drug lhan du rim bzhin spyi ltar mas rim nas yar sbyangs/ yas nas mar sbyangs/ mas nas yar sbyangs te thun grol/ thun gzhan ma rnams la'ang des 'gres so/ 'di skabs 'bru gsum bzlas pa 'bum ther bdun po 'gro dgos so/ gsang ba'i ru shan skabs kyi lag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gcig gi rgya byas te/ mgo la ma reg tsam bya ba dang*/ rang lus rgyas gdab skabs su rang lus hūm̐ yig rdul phra rab kyi cha tsam tshogs pa la sems bzung*/ yang hūm̐ yig gnas 'gyur nas phyag na rdo rje de'i grangs dang mnyam par bsgom nas hūm̐ yig gong ltar gsal/ mthar thams cad thugs ka'i hūm̐ la bsdu/

hūm̐ yig kyang 'ja' tshon nam mkhar yal ba ltar chos nyid kyi dbyings su bsdu'o/ mnyan btsal skabs su ngal gso bar bya zhes pa ni/ chos nyid kyi dbyings su mnyam par bzhag la gsungs/ rnal dbab skabs/ seng ge nyal stabs spyi ltar dang*/ 505)sor gzhug skabs su lag g.yas sdigs mdzub nam mkhar 'phang nas/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dkur brten/ rkang pa gyad kyi 'dor stabs bya/ mig gnyis lag g.yas kyi sdigs mdzub kyi phyogs su 'bru tshugs blta/ ngag gis ha ha brjod/ yang g.yon phyogs su go ldog nas de ltar bya zhing he he brjod/ yang sdigs mdzub gnyis nang bskor byed bzhin du ru lu ru lu brjod nas myur bar rgyugs/ de thog nas yang dal bus 'gro/ de nas g.yas sdigs mdzub nam mkhar 'phang ba nas bzung gong bzhin dal bus 'gro ba yan lan grangs ci nus kyi bar bya/ dka' ba'i tshe na byang chub sems dpa'i 'dug stangs byas nas mnyam par bdag mthar sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi skabs/ khams gsum gyi rten rags pa'i sgo gsum dag nas phra ba'i sgo gsum du smin tshul la/ spyir phra ba'i sgo gsum snang mched thob gsum la 'dod tshul dang*/ rtsa rlung thig le gsum la 'dod tshul yod kyang*/ da lta phra ba'i sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du smin tshul la bshad do/ sa chu gnyis po sku rdo rjer smin/ me rlung gnyis po gsung rdo rjer smin/ mkha' sems gnyis po thugs 506)rdo rjer smin pa'o/ 'di skabs rags pa'i sgo gsum dag sku dang ye shes su rdzogs/ rdo rje gsum du smin pa'o/ dngos gzhi'i sgo gsum gyi gnad gzir ba'i skabs su chos sku'i bzhugs stangs kyi khyad par/ rdo rje'i khu tshur gnyis brla g.yas g.yon gyi thad kar sar btsugs pa'am/ yang na rkang mthil kha sbyar ba'i g.yas g.yon gyi phyi rol du khu tshur gnyis sar btsugs nas sdod/ g.yo byed kyi rlung ni rtog tshogs phra rags thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyu dang*/

'phro ba las kyi rlung 'gyu 'phro'i rtog tshogs thams cad 'phel ba'i rgyu'o/ longs sku'i bzhugs stangs kyi khyad par spyi ltar dang*/ dbyings la rig pa 'dren pa'i gnad ni/ rig gdangs rdo rje lu gu brgyud dbyings kyi rab las mi 'da' ba'i don dang*/ sprul sku'i bzhugs stangs rkang pa'i long bu gnyis bshis nas rkang mgo g.yon steng dang*/ g.yas 'og tu bzhag nas mnyam par bsnol la/ lag pa'i sor mo gnyis phan tshun gcig bar du gcig bsnon te pus mor 'khyud de sdod/ don gnyis pa gnad gsum la brten nas zhes pa/ lus gnad bzhugs stangs/ ngag gnad smra bcad/ sems gnad ma 507)bcos rang babs su bzhag pa'o/ don gsum pa nyams su blangs pas gzhi dang lam gyi sgron ma'i skabs su lte ba'i rtsa mdud chags pa'i dus su 'di ltar/ gru gsum gyi dbus su tshogs brgyad kyi rtog pa 'char ba'i rten gyi rtsa brgyad chags pa/ dper na ri dwags e n+ya lta bu ste/ de ni seng ge rkang brgyad dam bse ru lta bu'o/ rgyang zhags chu'i sgron ma'i khams drug tshang ba'i rten gyi skabs su 'byung khams lnga dang*/ sems kyis khams dang drug ste/ me rlung gnyis gsung rdo rje/ mkha' sems gnyis thugs rdo rje ste/ sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du 'brel ba'o/ sba bsdu dag sbyor gyi rig pa 'od kyi gwa'ur sba ba'i skabs su rlung ro dbugs thengs gcig la sna bug gnyis nas mnyam du lan gsum bsal/ shes bya bum bsdu'i skabs su shes bya bum 'jug gi dgongs pa'i gnad ni chos can gyi snang ba thams cad chos nyid kyi dbyings su grol ba'o/ 'chi sbyong skabs su drang srong ngal bso ni lus drang srong tsog pu spyi ltar la/ lag g.yas rdo rje'i khu tshur dpyi thad du sar 'dzugs/ lag g.yon rdo rje'i khu tshur rje ngar gyi thad tsam du sar btsugs shing mig dbyings snang la gtad/ rang 508)bzhin sprul pa'i zhing lnga ni/

rigs lnga'i zhing khams dang dpal ri'i zhing khams sogs gsal kyang chog glang chen 'dug stangs spyi ltar dang*/ rang lus mnyam nyid bde lugs su nyal ba ni/ lus gan rkyal du log cing rkang lag thams cad phyir brgyangs nas 'dug go nyams gong 'phel skabs/ nang shes nyams rtsal rdzogs te bde nyams ri bo g.yo 'gul med pa lta bu/ gsal nyams rgya mtsho rlung gis ma bskyod pa lta bu/ stong nyams nam mkha' mtha' dbus med pa lta bu'o/ rig pa tshad phebs dus/ nang shes nyams dang snang nyams gnyis ka tshad la phebs te rdzogs par gsungs/ 'di'i dngos gzhi zhag ma brgya ru mtshams dam rgya byed nas bsgom dgos pa yin no/ skyabs rje mkha' 'gro rin po che'i zhal gsung rnams tshul khrims rdo rjes zin bris bgyis pa'o//
